rules.A: Raw file permutation PCG64 seed 0; random train/valid in permutation order; common queries in chronological order. Compare recall on all logged clicks.
rules.B: Earlier seconds in the same source calendar hour across all train-source rows; different user, equal last-20 length. Select uniformly from eligible records. Official empty fallback uses empty-user dot scores; fixed DIN fallback keeps the supplied Top-100 order. Candidate-only feeds [c,0,0] into frozen DIN head.
rules.C: SeedSequence([seed,20]) for within-query labels and [seed,21] for independent original-label ranks. Average per mixed impression. Evidence includes max individual absolute deviations.
rules.D: Sample from previously visible unclicked IDs in this impression; all positives must be visible. Use every chronological group to update after all queries at that second; preceding 24h left endpoint inclusive. Preserve original candidate order.
